name: Mara Vell, Cinder Cartographer
text: Before rolling movement, spend 1 charge to follow Mara's canonical same-reach route to a legal transition sector and stop there. She cannot bypass gates, locks, or blockers.

activeEffect.text: Mara Vell commits one sealed route bearing.

imagePrompt: Original Ashenreach follower portrait of a severe cinder cartographer in layered ash-grey industrial travel gear, brass route instruments, black map membranes, and a cold-blue signal lens at a ruined iron causeway fork, no text or logo.
flavor: She maps distances by how long ash takes to settle.
